title: Protected wild animals
rule: No one may kill, injure, capture, collect or take a listed wild animal (or its eggs, nest or lair) without both a permit from the Director to enter the reserve and a licence from the wildlife authority.
points: Two separate authorisations are required together: a Director's permit to enter the forest reserve, and a wildlife licence from the authority responsible for wildlife management and protection.
Offences relating to wild animals are dealt with under the Wildlife Conservation Act and other written laws, not this Act directly (s.87).
checks: Is the animal on a protected list
penalty: See the Wildlife Conservation Act (s. 87 of this Act defers to it).
